Media Release London, August 20, 2026 Deutsche Bank to take space at YY London, Canary Wharf, from early 2028
Deutsche Bank today announces that it has secured office space for its infrastructure functions at YY London in Canary Wharf, following an extensive review of options ahead of the expiry of its current lease at 10 Upper Bank Street in July 2028.
Building: Fully electric, targeting net-zero-in-operation Workplace amenities: Modern working areas, in-house cafe options, commuter facilities, rooftop gardens and terraces
Planned occupation: Early 2028
